exercises.instruction: Write the names of the types of films under the pictures. One of the types has two names.

items: 1 What’s on the cinema this week?
2 At the weekends, we just relax and look DVDs.
3 I didn’t like that film. I was boring.
4 Do you go to cinema very often?
5 It was a very funny film and I enjoyed very much.
6 I watched a good film in TV last night.

exercises.instruction: Match the words and phrases below with one of the film types from 22.1.
items: 1 ‘You are a British spy, Mr Bond!’
4 These films make you laugh a lot.
5 ‘I love you; I’ve always loved you!’
7 guns, horses, men in big hats, North America
